preToolUse.command: if echo "${TOOL_INPUT_PATH:-}" | grep -Eq '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)$'; then echo 'Ensure changed code still matches the approved spec.' >&2; fi
if echo "${TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND:-}" | grep -Eq '^git push'; then echo 'About to push changes. Confirm review and tests are complete.' >&2; fi
if echo "${TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND:-}" | grep -Eq '^git push.*(main|master)( |$)'; then echo 'Direct pushes to main/master are blocked. Use a PR flow.' >&2; exit 2; fi

postToolUse.command: if echo "${TOOL_INPUT_PATH:-}" | grep -Eq '\.tsx?$'; then npx tsc --noEmit --pretty 2>&1 | head -20 || true; fi
if echo "${TOOL_INPUT_PATH:-}" | grep -Eq '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|css|json)$'; then npx prettier --write "${TOOL_INPUT_PATH}" 2>/dev/null || true; fi

stop.command: echo 'Changed files in current session:' && git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null | head -10 || true
